verdict.rationale: Together AI is an API/SDK-first inference platform with OpenAI-compatible REST endpoints, official server-side SDKs (TypeScript/Python), batch inference, streaming via SSE, and structured/function-calling outputs — all natively usable in headless CI/automation pipelines without any UI dependency. Live probes confirm the API and status endpoints are reachable programmatically. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD example or GitHub Actions template in evidence, no documented CLI exit-code/scripting conventions, and no independent case study of a CI pipeline using Together AI headlessly.
